# EchoIsland source

Pinned source: `a7ebfff5887f7edae285f71fac049d025361880f`. Copyright and MIT terms are retained in [LICENSE](LICENSE); snapshot scope and modifications are recorded in [UPSTREAM.json](UPSTREAM.json).

FloatIsland uses the Rust host/runtime crates and the Windows terminal-focus implementation. The unrelated standalone Tauri application is excluded from Cargo workspace members. Build instructions for the integrated hosts are in [FloatIsland Build](../../docs/BUILD.md).
